newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Union Texas Petroleum started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Union Texas Petroleum started.

text.p: -- PaineWebber has initiated coverage of Union Texas Petroleum Holdings Inc with a rating of attractive, the brokerage firm said on Friday.
-- Analyst Ron Barone set a 12-month price target of 23 on shares of the Houston-based international oil and gas exploration and production comapany.
-- Barone estimated earnings per share of $1.56 in 1997 and $1.38 in 1998, compared with 1996 profit of $1.75 per share.
-- Barone cited new management at the company and said the stock was undervalued on cash flow and net asset bases.
-- Union Texas shares opened at 19-1/8, up 1/8.
